summary: ansible-core deprecations in Ansible 11: safe_eval helpers, ANSIBLE_CONNECTION_PATH (no effect), yum_repository async (gone in RHEL 8), and several yum_repository options with no dnf effect, such as deltarpm_metadata_percentage, gpgcakey, http_caching, keepalive and protect, all removed in core 2.22.
questions: Should I still set async in yum_repository?

answer_card.title: yum_repository option deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
`yum_repository` options to remove before ansible-core 2.22:
- `async` (removed in RHEL 8)
- `deltarpm_metadata_percentage`, `gpgcakey`, `http_caching`, `keepalive`, `metadata_expire_filter`, `mirrorlist_expire`, `protect`, `ssl_check_cert_permissions`, `ui_repoid_vars` (no effect with dnf)

Also deprecated: `AnsibleModule.safe_eval` / `common.safe_eval`, and `ANSIBLE_CONNECTION_PATH` (no effect).
